reviews.title: Excellent Quality Wired Headset
reviews.comment:
I have had this headset for over a year and I am quite happy with it. It's not perfect but luckily I found ways to fix the only major issues I have had with it.
PRO TIPS! To get the most out of this headset I have some recommendations:
I found that the headset on PC was too quiet and didn't get loud enough. To fix this I found out that you can download steelseries GG software and make adjustments in sonar, even though this headset is a completely different brand. In the game tab, scroll down past the EQ and there is an option to enable "volume boost." I turned this all the way up to +12 and the headset is SIGNIFICANTLY louder. Also you can fine tune EQ and save presets with sonar to dial in the sound profile. You're welcome!
The other issue I had was that the ear pads were stiff enough that they really irritated my head after a while, especially wearing glasses. Luckily this was also a relatively easy fix. I found a youtube video recommending replacement pads from Dekoni Audio. I purchased the Jerzee mesh pads and they are much softer and more comfortable than the original, which completely solved that problem. The headset does still create a bit of a pressure point at the top of my head because of the uniform shape of the headband cushion, so I wish it had a gap at the top like other headsets but it's not that bad.
https://www.amazon.com/Replacement-Sennheiser-Headphones-Headphone-Cushions/dp/B08DSL5KH8?ref_=ast_sto_dp&th=1
The headset overall is great. I love that it is open back, has a nice wide soundstage and the sound just feels big and rich with detail. Sound is a bit bass heavy and sometimes can sound muddy but you can change EQ in sonar to help with that some. I find that open back creates less listening fatigue over time and I can still hear my own voice without sidetone and I can hear whats going on around me.
Build quality is outstanding and comfort is really good (with the new pads at least). The design works very well to create a good fit around the head. Love the big deep ear cups and drivers.
I bought this headset used from amazon for I think $70, and there were no issues. At that price this headset is an incredible deal and I recommend 100%. Retail price is definitely steep, but you wont be disappointed with build quality. I'd say $60-$120 is an ideal price and feels like excellent value.

reviews.title: Fantastic headphones
reviews.comment:
First of all this is not a audiophile gaming headset, they're a gaming headset with audiophile features so if you're looking for audiophile open backs then just buy actual open back headphones.
H6pro open vs PC38x
Sound quality goes to PC38x
Build quality goes to H6pro by alot (just wow)
Comfort goes to H6pro
If youre looking for that pure neutral sound for gaming and listening to music then the PC38x are amazing and pretty comfortable but theyre very light plastic so for the money youre getting amazing sound and what feels like cheap plastic.
If youre looking for amazing sounding super comfortable gaming headphones that you can EQ the neutral tuned sound to whatever you like for gaming and music with the open back design that eliminates ear fatigue almost completely then the H6Pro open backs are for you.
The PC38x sound like 10% better but are built way cheaper and are less comfortable and theyre both the same price, your ears float inside the H6pros which makes the soundstage sound amazing for gaming. Everything about the H6pro says quality and comfort and you also get similar sound quality to the PC38x but the highs are a bit loud so you can hear footsteps really easily but gunfire can be uncomfortable which is why a DAC is amazing so you can turn down the slightly over tuned treble in the H6pro open backs.
Bottom line theyre amazing sounding, super comfortable, and youre getting quality worth the price tag. The PC37x are like half the price of the PC38x and sound almost as good so if youre not looking for the ultimate build quality and comfort with amazing sound of the H6PROs then the PC37x are in the proper price bracket for what youre getting.

reviews.title: Worth the price, decent replacement
reviews.comment: I got these as a replacement for my gsx 600 headset that fell apart after 2 1/2 years. Since they have doubled in price since i last bought them i was looking for a cheaper but better built alternative. These seem to be it. The sound quality isn't as good but it is close and after messing with my external sound card It has improved. They are built much better and don't have any plastic seams that are guaranteed to break like the gsx 600 (I'd been dealing with a broken pair for about 2 years). Overall: sound quality is good but not fantastic, build quality seems to be great, worth the price for sure but maybe not with out a EQ program or external sound card.

reviews.title: Great purchase for the price.
reviews.comment: Bought a few months back, works like a champ. Came with instructions, I didn’t use because it was really self explanatory. lol. Plug and play basically. It came with two separate cords, one with a mic and headset port. Another with a single port if you wanted to plug in to a switch or something. Great audio, pretty transparent though. I hear more exterior sound than other pair but you get used to it. Pretty microphone. Noise cancellation works great, no complaints from my buddies when we play. Happy with this product.
